description: BORES is a Python three-dimensional black-oil reservoir modelling package for oil, water and gas flow. It provides model construction, wells, faults, fractures, simulation controls and result-analysis interfaces. The provider is BORES developer, ti-oluwa. Coverage: The software is generic and constructs user-defined grids. Its origin is an undergraduate petroleum-engineering project, not a documented field deployment. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The PyPI metadata supplies the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3. Dependency licences remain separate. Limitations: The provider explicitly excludes production use and critical field-development decisions and says full API documentation is forthcoming. Results require comparison with established simulators. For simulation it supports educational and exploratory reservoir-flow experiments. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Unrelated mentions of boreholes do not establish identity.
